description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'EventBusRegistrationAdapter' that integrates registration services with the Vert.x event bus. It manages processing registration-related requests, particularly device registration assertions, and includes tracing, validation, and response handling functionalities.

classes.name: EventBusRegistrationAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class that integrates registration service requests with Vert.x event bus, handling registration assertions, validations, and tracing.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the registration service to which requests will be forwarded.

methods.name: getEventBusAddress
methods.description: Returns the address on the Vert.x event bus where registration messages are received.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming registration messages, routing 'assert' actions to specific handler methods or handling custom operations.

methods.name: processAssertRequest
methods.description: Handles 'assert registration' requests, performing validation, tracing, and calling the registration service.

methods.name: processCustomRegistrationMessage
methods.description: Default handler for unsupported registration operations, returning a failed future with a 400 error.

methods.name: isGatewaySupportedForDevice
methods.description: Determines whether a gateway is supported for a device based on registration info.

methods.name: newChildSpan
methods.description: Creates a new tracing span for the registration operation, tagging it with relevant context.

methods.name: handleUnimplementedOperation
methods.description: Handles unimplemented operations, returning a 501 Not Implemented response.

methods.name: isGatewayAuthorized
methods.description: Checks whether a gateway is authorized to act on behalf of a device based on registration data.

methods.name: getRegistrationAssertionCacheDirective
methods.description: Provides cache control directive for registration assertion responses, defaulting to a max age.

methods.name: getResultPayload
methods.description: Constructs a JSON object encapsulating registration result data.
